entries.name: 4G Activation
entries.description: Enables 4G transmission on the aircraft. 128 frames with the aircraft serial embedded in each payload. Sent in a single round with 10ms between frames.

frames.note: Each frame's payload is a 3-byte prefix (00 00 01) followed by the ASCII aircraft serial; the third prefix byte is the activation flag (00 = off, 01 = on). Frame i has cmd_id=i (0..127). The serial is read from the controller at runtime via probeSerial().

entries.name: CE Restore
entries.description: Resets the radio to its factory-flashed default region (CE for CE units, FCC for FCC units). Single frame.

frames.note: RADIO reset region to default (dst=ANY idx 1)

entries.name: Device Info
entries.description: Queries the controller for hardware version, bootloader version, and app version. Uses a request/response exchange instead of fire-and-forget.

frames.note: GENERAL VersionInquiry to ANY — returns HW version, LDR version, app version

entries.name: FCC Universal
entries.description: Switches the radio from CE to FCC mode — higher power, more channels. Works on all DJI aircraft models.

frames.note: AUTOTEST set: enter service mode (dst=SVO)
RADIO set region param to FCC (01) (dst=REMOTE_RADIO)
FLYCONTROLLER write param (cmd 0xF9)
GENERAL activate change (dst=WM330_OR_WM220)
GENERAL set country code '11' (dst=LB_68013_SKY idx 3)
FLYCONTROLLER write param (cmd 0xAF)
WIFI set channel group AU 2.4G (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
WIFI set channel group AU 5.8G (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
OFDM set 2.4G power limit (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
OFDM set 5.8G power limit (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
WIFI write channel map (dst=WIFI)
WIFI set channel flag (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
FLYCONTROLLER write param ON (dst=SVO idx 4)
FLYCONTROLLER write param OFF (dst=SVO idx 4)
GENERAL set country code '22' (dst=LB_68013_SKY idx 3)
FLYCONTROLLER write param (cmd 0xF9)
FLYCONTROLLER write param (cmd 0xF9)
RADIO set parameter 03 (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
RADIO set parameter 01 (dst=LB_MCU_SKY)
RADIO commit region change (dst=REMOTE_RADIO)
AUTOTEST exit service mode (dst=SVO)

entries.name: FCC Keepalive
entries.description: Re-applies FCC radio mode every 2s over TCP 40009 to prevent DJI Fly from resetting to CE. Uses only TCP-confirmed-working frames.

frames.note: AUTOTEST enter service mode
RADIO set region to FCC (01)
RADIO commit region change
AUTOTEST exit service mode

entries.name: LED Off
entries.description: Turns off the aircraft arm LEDs. Requires DJI Fly running with aircraft connected. Uses port 40007 with outer wrapper. Sent as 2 bursts of 5 writes (10 total) with 100ms between each — see FccViewModel.setLed(). Does NOT hold HardwareLock so the FCC keepalive continues during the LED command.

frames.note: FLYCONTROLLER write param: LED OFF

entries.name: LED On
entries.description: Turns on the aircraft arm LEDs. Requires DJI Fly running with aircraft connected. Uses port 40007 with outer wrapper. Sent as 2 bursts of 5 writes (10 total) with 100ms between each — see FccViewModel.setLed(). Does NOT hold HardwareLock so the FCC keepalive continues during the LED command.

frames.note: FLYCONTROLLER write param: LED ON
